entities.summary: After the Jesuit expulsion, the Reduction missions were looted and collapsed. Paraguay became an isolated, impoverished backwater of the Viceroyalty of the Río de la Plata (created 1776). Buenos Aires sought to dominate Paraguay, but Paraguayans repelled a Porteño army led by Manuel Belgrano in Janu
